test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

B _ V _ _ T _ G B T _ G _ _ V G

options.text: T G B V V B T
T G G B V B G
G T B V V B G
T G B V G V B

solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) T G B V V B T**

B **T** V **G** / **B** T **V** G / B T **V** G / **B** **T** V G → Follows pattern of **BTVG** .

Option 2) T G G B V B G

B **T** V **G** / **G** T **B** G / B T **V** G / **B** **G** V G → Does not follow pattern.

Option 3) G T B V V B G

B **G** V **T** / **B** T **V** G / B T **V** G / **B** **G** V G → Does not follow pattern.

Option 4) T G B V G V B

B **T** V **G** **B** T **V** G B T **G** G **V** **B** V G → Does not follow pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
